correctness.rationale: For every odd q and gcd(d,q+1)=2, injectivity forces r odd. The cosetwise block sign formula gives the quadratic character of the product of q+1 fiber scalars. This product is omega^(q(r-1)/2) times (a^((q+1)/2)-(-1)^((q+1)/2))^2. A nonsquare nonzero a would force its square factor to lie outside F_q, contradiction. For a square or zero the factor is a nonzero square in F_q, leaving sign (-1)^((r-1)/2). Exact finite computations include q=9 and do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: A complete coefficient-independent sign classification across every odd quadratic finite field and every two-to-one exponent is a natural dynamical invariant for recently classified permutation binomials. The necessary square-class obstruction and uniform sign explain a structural distinction from coprime-index families where sign varies with the coefficient. This is not an arbitrary finite slice or table recomputation; no claim is made about counts of permissible coefficients, cycles or other index types.
